<div class="card-body">
'''Brainiac''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブレイニアック</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">*戦闘力＝√3 (X－Y) +2 (A－B) +π（最低でも戦闘力＝1）。X＝ダークサイドの手札の枚数、Y＝ライトサイドの手札の枚数、A＝場に出ているカードのダークアイコンの合計数、B＝場に出ているカードのライトアイコンの合計数、π＝3.141592653589793238462643383...である。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ボシェックはこのシニティーンの男性に“ブレイニアック（頭でっかち）”というあだ名をつけた。その名にふさわしく、彼はハイパースペースの座標を自分の頭で計算できる。レイアの脱獄作戦も、彼が立案していたらさぞかし…</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Brainiac.

'''Card text:''' *Power = √3 (X−Y) +2 (A−B) + π (power is at least 1). X is the Dark Side hand size. Y is the Light Side hand size. A is the total Dark icons on table. B is the total Light icons on table. π is 3.141592653589793238462643383…

'''Lore:''' Boshek gave this Sanyassan male the nickname Brainiac (big-headed). True to the name, he can calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. If only he had been the one to plan Leia's escape…

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore glosses the nickname as 頭でっかち.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Brainiac|Brainiac]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Brainiac (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R56 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R56. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Brainiac-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
